## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `elastic-elasticcloud-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Sign up and log in to Elastic Cloud

1. <!-- manual: Visit the [Elastic Cloud registration page](https://cloud.elastic.co/registration). -->
2. <!-- manual: Fill in your account details including email, password, and organization information. -->
3. Verify your email address by selecting the verification link sent to your email.
4. <!-- manual: Complete your profile setup, accept the terms of service, and choose your subscription plan. -->
5. <!-- manual: Log in at [cloud.elastic.co/login](https://cloud.elastic.co/login) using your credentials (or Google/Microsoft SSO). -->

## Step 3: Create an Elastic Cloud deployment

1. From the dashboard, select **Create deployment**.
2. <!-- manual: Choose your cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) and region. -->
3. <!-- manual: Configure the deployment size, features, and Elastic Stack version. -->
4. Select **Create deployment** and wait for it to become ready.

## Step 4: Navigate to organization settings

1. From the dashboard, select **Organization** in the top navigation.
2. <!-- manual: Go to the organization management page to view your Organization ID and settings. -->
3. Select **API keys**.

## Step 5: Create an API key

1. In the **API keys** tab, select **Create API key**.
2. <!-- manual: Provide a name for the key (for example, Ballerina Connector). -->
3. <!-- manual: Set an expiration period (3 months, 6 months, or 1 year). -->
4. <!-- manual: Assign the appropriate roles for your use case. -->
5. Select **Create API key** to generate the credentials.
6. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
